record_audits.database_subject: A Novel Antimicrobial Peptide (Kassinatuerin-3) Isolated from the Skin Secretion of the African Frog,Kassina senegalensis
record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (50%) to AamAP1. I: 30%; Activity: moderately to weakly active against S. aureus (MIC 16-32 uM), MRSA (MIC 32-64 uM), E.faecalis (MIC 128 uM), E.coli (MIC>512 uM), P.aeruginosa (>512 uM), and C. albicans (MIC 64-128 uM). Cf. melittin (MIC 1-8 uM, mostly). The peptide displayed dose-dependent anticancer effects on cell lines. In vitro Toxicity: no detectable hemolysis till 160 uM (not hemo.lytic). Structure: Random in water and helical in TFE (50%). Updated 7/2021; 12/2024
